## History

Carrie Sloane is a schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She attends the local school and participates in community social gatherings alongside her peers, including Diana's party where the girls play a game of dares. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks her ankle during the party, Carrie is among the schoolmates, friends, and neighbors who visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her seven-week recovery. Later in the autumn, she continues her schooling under the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), as the class prepares for a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag.
